text: Intel Arc integrated graphics can handle 3D modeling, long video edits, and heavy exports while unplugged
quote: Tackle 3D models, long edits, and heavy exports with Intel® Arc™ graphics, even unplugged and on-the-go.

text: Supports AI-accelerated creative apps from 350+ software partners for photo editing and rendering
quote: Edit photo libraries and render at lightning speed, using AI apps from over 350 software partners.

text: Intel Arc graphics plus XeSS 3 AI upscaling deliver higher, smoother frame rates on mobile devices
quote: More GPU performance from Intel® Arc™ graphics and AI-enhanced gameplay with Intel® XeSS 3 give you ultra-smooth FPS on the go.

text: Intel Xe Media Engine provides hardware video encode/decode for simultaneous streaming, editing, and gaming
quote: Play, stream, and edit, all at once. Intel Xe Media Engine delivers sharp, high-def video without compromising game graphics.

text: Compatible with major game stores/services (Steam, Epic, Battle.net, Xbox Game Pass) for full game library support
quote: Load up thousands of AAA and indie titles for a full gaming experience across Steam, Epic, Battle.net, and Xbox Game Pass.

text: Copilot+ enables voice-command control to get answers, edit content, and execute tasks
quote: Say it and Copilot+ helps do it... Use voice commands to get answers, edit content, and turn ideas into reality.

text: Dedicated low-power AI engines (NPU) and intelligent power management improve performance-per-watt on battery
quote: Dedicated low-power AI engines and intelligent power management drive smart performance, even when you leave the charger behind.

text: Bluetooth 6 support provides extended wireless range and reliability
quote: Crystal-clear Bluetooth™ 6 lets you walk away further than ever. Trusted to run like no other.

text: oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations enable local LLM and image-generation inference on Core Ultra CPUs/GPUs
quote: Maximize AI PC inference capabilities from large language models (LLM) to image generation with Intel® oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) and PyTorch optimizations for Intel® Core™ Ultra processors (series 2) and Intel® Arc™ GPUs.

text: Intel VTune Profiler adds analysis tools for optimizing performance on Intel client GPUs and NPUs
quote: Optimize performance on client GPUs and NPUs from Intel with new analysis tool features in Intel® VTune™ Profiler.

text: Enhanced SYCL interoperability with Vulkan and DirectX 12 enables real-time processing across more imaging formats
quote: Achieve real-time processing and display on a broader array of imaging formats through enhanced SYCL\* interoperability with Vulkan\* and Microsoft DirectX\* 12 APIs.
